speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren. The day is Lady Day, and the day is sufficient.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He said a like thing on Sunday, and Sunday was not brief. I am here. That is the part of me he can count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am here. The quarter is paid. I have not brought the receipt into the pew.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A receipt is between a man and his house. This hour is the day. Let it be the day, and not a saddle-bag.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Let it. I have had my twenty shillings, and I can sit one evening without naming them again. Mark me. I am capable of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then sit. I leave in the morning. The church remains, which is more than I can claim for myself.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Go when you must. I shall not preach you as far as the door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He will not. Amen is enough of a farewell from a pew.
